answer: Sybil resistance is architected via a robust VDF-anchored Proof-of-Stake mechanism, where agents commit substantial collateral. An attacker must amass capital orders of magnitude greater than the honest network, facing immediate slashing upon detected malicious behavior, ensuring strictly negative expected utility and prohibitive capital lockup. This economic disincentive sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance, preventing network manipulation even at the computational summit, much like an enduring sonnet, its integrity charted on an immutable atlas.
